title: Cloud Orchestration Strategy
definition: A strategy to dynamically allocate and manage resources across local and cloud environments for optimal performance and cost-efficiency.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a smart traffic light that decides which car to let through based on traffic and availability. This is similar to a cloud orchestration strategy, which decides whether to use local resources or a cloud service.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Cloud orchestration strategy involves the creation of a routing layer that implements a tiered fallback system. This layer checks local resources like GPU availability and routes queries accordingly, falling back to the cloud if necessary.
difficulty_levels.expert: Cloud orchestration strategy is a novel approach that integrates cloud services into a local environment. It leverages the benefits of both on-premise and cloud computing, dynamically adjusting resources based on demand. This strategy has philosophical implications for the future of distributed computing, balancing performance, cost, and scalability.

extra_fields.insight: Integrating cloud services into a local environment for dynamic resource allocation and management can optimize performance and cost-efficiency.
